name: Professional greeting
description: The agent opens with a polite greeting or introduction.

name: Acknowledge the issue
description: The agent acknowledges the customer's actual concern or expresses relevant empathy.

name: Clear next steps
description: The agent gives an actionable next step or explains a completed action relevant to the customer's issue. Do not require a refund if policy does not permit one.

name: Confirm the outcome
description: The agent checks whether the customer's issue was addressed or whether further help is needed. A polite goodbye alone is not resolution confirmation.

name: Professional closing
description: The agent closes politely when the conversation actually ends.
